candidate_evidence.quote: BP102 is an autologous B7-H3 CAR-T cell product manufactured from the participant's peripheral blood mononuclear cells.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Recurrent or refractory glioblastoma with measurable disease at enrollment.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Peak Concentration (Cmax) of B7-H3 CAR-T in peripheral blood (PB) and cerebral spinal fluid (CSF)

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: The concentration of cytokines (IL-1, IL-2, IL-6, IL-10, TNF-α, IFN-γ) in PB and CSF
To characterize the pharmacokinetic (PK) and pharmacodynamic (PD) profiles of BP102.

role_evidence.quote: BP102 is an autologous B7-H3 CAR-T cell product manufactured from the participant's peripheral blood mononuclear cells.

agents.drug_class_hint: autologous B7-H3-targeted CAR-T cell therapy, intracranial via Ommaya reservoir
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: B7-H3 CAR-T cells are designed to recognize B7-H3 expressed on glioblastoma cells.

biomarkers.biomarker_other: B7-H3 expression (central laboratory analysis of submitted tumour tissue)

source_quote.quote: Available tumor tissue must be submitted for central laboratory analysis of B7-H3 expression.

coder_notes: CAR-T cell therapy only, excluded intervention type. B7-H3 expression is analysed centrally but a minimum expression level is not stated as an entry requirement, so coded exploratory_correlative; it relates to a CAR-T, not a candidate. CSF PK and cytokine/T-cell phenotype pharmacodynamics are planned for the CAR-T product.
